title: Untrack Generated Outputs
summary: Hardened .gitignore for 🤖generated, 🔌plugin-modules, wasm, maps, pkg, 🟨boot.js, tokens/next-env/forge env d.ts, Palette.g.cs. Retargeted schema, ui-asset, and styling generators to emoji output paths. Added schema build.rs and graph-manifest auto-generate on missing artifacts. Wired workspace codegen into SetupScript (node nx.js + direct semio-asset build). Untracked ~2756 generated paths (see untrack-paths.txt). Verified zero tracked outputs outside tickets, ignore rules, regeneration, plugin-registry:check, and cargo check on schema + graph-manifest crates.
description: Stop checking in toolchain outputs (wasm/js/d.ts bundles, plugin-modules, boot.js, and all 🤖generated codegen). Harden .gitignore, fix stale generator paths, wire zero-touch regeneration into setup, and untrack everything already committed—lock files stay.
